# Regenerating SpacetimeDB Bindings

**NEVER manually modify autogenerated files in `module_bindings/`.** Always use the custom generator binary instead, and **ALWAYS execute `cargo fmt` immediately after generating**. Aside from running `cargo fmt` to match workspace formatting, do NOT manually edit or modify generated files.

When regenerating SpacetimeDB module bindings for the admin app or sender, you MUST use the local custom `spacetimedb-cli` debug or release binary located at:
`../SpacetimeDB/target/release/spacetimedb-cli` or `../SpacetimeDB/target/debug/spacetimedb-cli`.

Note: Because `../SpacetimeDB` is located in the sibling directory outside this workspace, commands accessing it must run with `BypassSandbox: true`.

Do NOT use the system `spacetimedb-cli` or `spacetime generate`.

### Commands

Run both commands together or individually (always chaining `cargo fmt`):
```bash
../SpacetimeDB/target/release/spacetimedb-cli generate --lang=dioxus -p server -o admin/src/module_bindings/ && ../SpacetimeDB/target/release/spacetimedb-cli generate --lang=rust -p server -o sender/src/module_bindings/ && cargo fmt
```

- For the Dioxus Admin application:
```bash
../SpacetimeDB/target/release/spacetimedb-cli generate --lang=dioxus -p server -o admin/src/module_bindings/ && cargo fmt -p admin
```

- For the Rust Sender service:
```bash
../SpacetimeDB/target/release/spacetimedb-cli generate --lang=rust -p server -o sender/src/module_bindings/ && cargo fmt -p sender
```

When prompted by the CLI regarding stale files to delete, confirm deletion.
